design.schema: original 540 reference features + measured or predicted hinge minus frozen hinge, push grasp, push open, progress through named reference phase
design.nominal_guard: both nominal trajectories included; zero residual for error <= 0.2 deg, ramp 0.2–0.4 deg; negative errors outside single positive training support remain inactive
design.labels: all full 20ms supervised teacher intervals with a frozen judge pass; includes legal early hold on the frozen open clock
design.fit: one full-batch physical-unit smooth ridge solve. 25 linear spline knots per reference phase; second-difference penalty .06 plus .002 ridge
design.channels: six arm angles in rad with response linear in measured hinge error; jaw width in m with a saturated gain. No leg/wheel changes
design.nonlinear_scaling: arm scaling capped at 2 x 2.8deg; jaw reaches full delayed-close command from 1deg, then saturates
design.clock: one common nominal library per side; no perturbed or C-specific reference; zero pull residual
